returns.title: Returns & Refunds Policy | Tallaby
returns.description: How returns work in stores built on Tallaby: the {days}-day return window, who pays return shipping, and how your refund is issued.
returns.heading: Returns & Refunds
returns.intro: Received the wrong item, or changed your mind? Here's how returns work in stores built on Tallaby.
returns.windowBody: All orders can be cancelled or returned within {days} days of purchase. Items need to come back in the condition you received them, with their original packaging and any included accessories. Some products can't be returned for hygiene or safety reasons — where that applies, it's noted on the product page.
returns.howToBody: Cancellations and returns are requested on the website of the store you ordered from. Sign in to your account, go to My Orders, open the order and select the item you want to cancel or return. You'll get a return (RMA) number to track your request.
returns.reasonsIntro: You can request a return for reasons including:
returns.costFreeBody: All cancellations and returns within {days} days of purchase are free of charge.
returns.costPaidBody: Delivery fees apply on cancelled or returned orders — the delivery fee you paid on the original order is not refunded.
returns.refundBody: The value of a cancelled or returned order is refunded through the same payment method you used for the purchase. Your refund is processed within seven days of us receiving your cancellation request or the returned product.
returns.refundMethod1: Refunds always go back the way you paid — you don't need to pick a refund method
returns.refundMethod2: When the amount appears in a card holder's balance varies according to the card issuer's policy
returns.refundMethod3: Delivery dates depend on the delivery mode you choose when placing your order, and are estimates that may vary with shipping companies' backlog
returns.helpBody: Contact our support team and we'll help you sort it out.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery in Egypt | Tallaby
shipping.description: How delivery works in stores built on Tallaby: delivery fees, typical delivery times by governorate, and how to track your order.
shipping.heading: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.intro: Each store built on Tallaby delivers its own orders, with its own riders or a shipping company. Here's what to expect from your order.
shipping.sellerFreeDeliveryBody: Some stores offer free delivery on individual products whatever your order total — look for the free delivery badge on the product page.
shipping.costBody: The delivery fee is calculated automatically at checkout from your delivery governorate and the weight of the products in your order. You always see the exact amount before you confirm your order.
shipping.timingMetro: Cairo and Giza: typically {metro} business days
shipping.timingBody: These are estimates, not guaranteed dates. Delivery dates are determined by the delivery mode you choose when placing your order, and may vary with shipping companies' backlog, the seller's location, your governorate, product availability and public holidays. Orders placed on a weekend or holiday are usually processed the next business day.
shipping.coverageBody: Stores deliver to governorates across Egypt: Cairo, Giza and Alexandria, the Delta and Canal governorates, Upper Egypt, Sinai, Matrouh and the New Valley. Available delivery areas are confirmed at checkout based on your address.
shipping.multiSellerTitle: Orders from more than one store
shipping.multiSellerBody: Each store takes and delivers its own orders, with its own cart and checkout. If you order from two stores, you place two separate orders, and they arrive separately.
shipping.trackingBody: Once your order is placed, you can follow its status from My Orders in your account. Ordered as a guest? Use the order confirmation link sent to you after checkout.
shipping.codNote: Paying cash on delivery? You'll pay the courier the full order amount when your order arrives. Cash on delivery isn't available on orders with a high delivery cost.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy | Tallaby
cookies.description: How Tallaby uses cookies to keep you signed in and remember your cart.
cookies.heading: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Cookies are small files stored on your device that help websites work. Here's how Tallaby uses them.
cookies.whatBody: Tallaby uses essential cookies to keep you signed in, remember your language preference, and maintain your shopping cart between visits. On tallaby.com, analytics and advertising cookies from Google Analytics and the Meta Pixel are set only if you accept them.
cookies.controlBody: You can change your choice at any time through the Cookie settings link in the footer. You can also control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Note that blocking essential cookies may prevent you from staying signed in or using your cart.

payment.title: Payment Methods | Tallaby
payment.description: The ways customers can pay in stores built on Tallaby: cash on delivery, mobile wallet, InstaPay or card. Each store chooses what it offers.
payment.heading: Payment Methods
payment.intro: Choose the payment method that works best for you at checkout.
payment.codBody: Pay in cash when your order is delivered to your door. Not available for orders with high shipping costs.
payment.walletBody: Pay using your mobile wallet at checkout.
payment.instapayBody: Pay instantly using InstaPay at checkout.
payment.cardBody: Pay securely by credit or debit card using Paymob. Your card details are handled directly by Paymob — Tallaby does not store them.

post.ctaTitle: Ready to put a price on it?
post.ctaBody: Create your store free and add your first product in minutes.

article.lede: Pricing is the decision most new sellers get wrong, usually by charging too little. A low price feels safe, but it leaves no room for shipping surprises, returns or a discount code when you need one. Here's a simple way to get it right.
article.s1Body: Add up everything it takes to get one unit ready to ship: materials or wholesale price, packaging, labels and any printing. If you make the product yourself, include your time.
article.s2: 2. Add the costs you don't see
article.s3: 3. Choose a margin you can live with
article.s3Body: For most handmade and small-batch goods, a margin between 50% and 100% on top of cost leaves room to grow. Lower margins can work for high-volume items, but only if your orders really are high volume.
article.quote: If a 10% discount would make you lose money, your price is too low.
article.s4Body: Look at three or four brands selling something similar. You don't need to be the cheapest; you need to be clearly worth it. Then round to a clean number: 449 or 450 reads better than 437.
article.tip: Tip: test a price for two weeks before changing it. Small samples move around a lot.

about.story2: We built a store builder that fits how they actually work: Arabic first, mobile first, cash and online payments, local shipping, and a price that only kicks in when they make sales.

items.q: How long does it take to set up a store?
items.a: Signup takes under a minute: your store link, email and password, or Google. After that you pick a template, add products and publish whenever you're ready.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. Everything from design to publishing is visual. If you can use a phone, you can run your store.

items.q: Can I move products from another store?
items.a: Yes. Upload a CSV of your products from the Products page, or ask support to help with the move.

items.q: Can I change templates after publishing?
items.a: Yes, anytime. Your products, orders and settings stay the same.

items.q: Does my store support Arabic and English?
items.a: Yes. Every template supports both directions, and you can add product details in both languages.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Your store starts on a free address like yourbrand.tallaby.com. You can connect a domain you own from Settings, then update its DNS records.

items.q: Can I change my store link?
items.a: Yes, from Settings, if the new link is available. The old link redirects to the new one for 30 days.

how.title: Four steps from link to cash

steps.title: Get your link
steps.body: Create a free seller account on Tallaby, then open “Earn with us” in your dashboard to find your link and referral code.

steps.title: Share it
steps.body: Copy it or share it on WhatsApp and Facebook with anyone who wants to start an online store. Whoever opens your link and signs up within 60 days counts for you.

steps.title: Earn 20% for life
steps.body: Every time a seller you brought tops up their store wallet successfully, 20% of the amount is credited to you, every time, with no end date.

steps.title: Withdraw in cash
steps.body: After 10 successful referrals and 10 stores, request your available balance (EGP 500 or more) to your bank account or Vodafone Cash.

example.title: An EGP 1,000 top-up = EGP 200 for you
example.body: A seller who signed up through your link tops up their store wallet with EGP 1,000? You earn EGP 200 right away. If they top up again, you earn 20% again.

terms.title: The program's terms, plainly
items: The commission is 20% of every successful store-wallet top-up by a seller who signed up through your link, for life.
Commissions are paid in cash to a bank account or Vodafone Cash, never as credit in your store wallet.
A referral counts as successful once the referred seller's first wallet top-up succeeds.
Withdrawal opens after at least 10 successful referrals and at least 10 stores created through your link. They are two separate counts, and a seller who creates 3 stores counts as 3 stores.
The minimum withdrawal is EGP 500, each request covers your whole available balance, and you can have one open request at a time.
A commission can be withdrawn as soon as it is credited, with no waiting period.
Your link is remembered for 60 days and the first link a person opens is the one that counts. The referrer can't be changed after signup, and you can't refer yourself.
Referral links are for Tallaby seller accounts only.
Tallaby cancels commissions from fake accounts and self-referrals, and withdrawals are paused while your account isn't active.

items.a: Anyone with a Tallaby seller account. Creating one is free, and your link is ready on the “Earn with us” page of your dashboard.
20% of every amount a seller you brought successfully tops up in their store wallet, for life. The EGP 100 welcome gift isn't a top-up, so it earns no commission.
Once you reach at least 10 successful referrals and at least 10 stores created through your link, and your available balance is EGP 500 or more. After that, withdrawal stays open for you.
Request a withdrawal on the “Earn with us” page and choose a bank account or Vodafone Cash. The Tallaby team transfers your whole available balance and lets you know when it's paid.

items.q: Do I see the details of the sellers I referred?
items.a: You see the store name, signup date, number of stores, total topped up and your commission from it, never their phone number or email.

items.q: Does a seller I referred pay more?
items.a: No. They pay Tallaby's usual prices like every seller; Tallaby pays your commission.
